name: AutisMind-AI
description: Full-stack AI-powered platform for early autism screening featuring an interactive user interface and intelligent prediction modules with real-time assessment workflows.
challenge: Providing clinical-grade behavioral predictions with sub-50ms execution delay under strict user privacy constraints.
solution: Developed REST API-based communication between frontend and backend services for real-time assessment workflows and intelligent prediction pipelines.

narrative.problem: Early autism screening tools are often inaccessible or non-interactive. Traditional platforms lack integrated prediction pipelines that parents and clinicians can easily navigate.
narrative.architecture: Engineered full-stack architecture coupling interactive React interfaces with Python machine learning and computer vision inference modules via asynchronous REST APIs.
narrative.decisions: Leveraged client-side interactive workflows with high-throughput API endpoints to guarantee instant assessment feedback without latency.
narrative.metrics: Live on Vercel with real-time interactive assessment workflows.

name: PrithviQ
tagline: AI Waste Detection & Recycling Optimization System
description: AI-driven monitoring system using computer vision to detect, classify, and quantify plastic waste using smartphone and drone imagery, paired with an analytical dashboard for NGOs.
challenge: Accurately identifying and categorizing plastic waste densities across heterogeneous drone and smartphone aerial imagery angles.
solution: Developed computer vision detection models and built an analytical dashboard for NGOs and government agencies to optimize cleanup operations (aligned with UN SDG 12 & SDG 14).

narrative.problem: Municipalities and NGOs lack automated spatial data to identify plastic waste accumulation zones and route cleanup resources efficiently.
narrative.architecture: Implemented computer vision pipeline trained on aerial drone feeds and handheld imagery, serving classified density overlays to an administrative dashboard.
narrative.decisions: Aligned data structures with UN SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water) for direct NGO policy applicability.
narrative.metrics: Automated waste classification and spatial analytics dashboard.

name: CampuSwap
description: Full-stack marketplace platform enabling university students to buy, sell, and exchange textbooks and campus resources securely with authenticated transaction workflows.
challenge: Designing a secure, responsive student exchange platform with authenticated user access and low-latency database queries.
solution: Designed responsive frontend interfaces, integrated backend services through RESTful APIs, and structured scalable PostgreSQL models supporting efficient data storage and retrieval.

narrative.problem: University students face high fees and unreliable informal channels when trading textbooks, electronics, and study materials on campus.
narrative.architecture: Engineered modular full-stack application with Express.js REST APIs, PostgreSQL relational schemas, user authentication, and product listing workflows.
narrative.decisions: Utilized PostgreSQL for ACID-compliant transaction records and strict relational integrity across student users and product inventory.
narrative.metrics: Full-stack authenticated marketplace with scalable relational database.
